# Hifin Template Name

> A place to keep notes.

The app serves this file at /llms.txt, for agents (llmstxt.org). Keep it
in step with the app: what it is, and what an agent can do in it.

## Use it with an agent

- [MCP server](/mcp): the app's features as tools, over Streamable HTTP.
  list_notes reads the notes; add_note adds one.
